title: AMR Cartography: a generalisable framework for studying multivariate drug resistance
description: Code, analysis workflows and manuscript source data for Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) Cartography — a multidimensional-scaling and multivariate linear mixed model framework for analysing continuous, correlated minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) profiles, applied to beta-lactam resistance in Streptococcus pneumoniae.
